§6Computer Cases§f

§aBuild a custom computer by picking a case and stuffing it with parts!§f
OpenComputers doesn't give you a ready-made computer. You grab a case, slot in a CPU, RAM, a GPU, and whatever else you need, then boot it up.

§6Case Tiers§f:
§bTier 1§f: 2 card slots, 2 container slots, 2 expansion slots.
§bTier 2§f: More room for mid-tier components.
§bTier 3§f: 3 card, 3 container, 3 expansion slots. The works.

§6What Goes Inside§f:
§bCPU§f: Tier 1 supports 8 components, Tier 2 supports 12, Tier 3 supports 16.
§bRAM§f: Six levels from 192 KB up to 1024 KB, split across three tiers.
§bGPU§f: Tier 1 is 50x16 monochrome, Tier 2 is 80x25 with 16 colors, Tier 3 is 160x50 with 256 colors.

Shift-right-click a placed case to open the component GUI. Drag parts in, hit power, and you've got a computer.

§ePS:§f The computer costs 0.5 energy per tick when running. Cases charge at 5/10/20 energy per tick depending on tier.
